title: Construction of an irreducible binary modulus
statement: For each positive integer $\ell$, the construction assigns a coefficient vector $m\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$ such that the monic polynomial $X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$ is irreducible over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
